what: An agent's request (no `cargo` targets) on a checkout whose first build wrote its lock files lost its checkout: the view opened again with the lock files has a root no head is at, so `viewed` named it an agent's view (`root: None`). That build kept no front end, no answer and posted no carry. 16 of serve::tests' 20 standing failures were this, since the sim's checkouts have no lock file; the suite had been blind to front-end reuse.
cost: 16 serve::tests red for days, read as noise; the carry driver's daemon tests failed on it
cause: a checkout's identity was derived from a content id (which head is at this root) instead of carried from the request that named it
class: identity derived by a reverse lookup on content, which breaks when the content moves under the same owner
prevention: the job carries what its request named; a reverse lookup on a root id is only for a request that names nothing
fix: Job::relocated records each lock-written view's checkout; viewed reads it before the heads. Control: with the lookup off, a_build_lowers_into_the_front_end_its_last_build_stored and three others fail again.
